title: The Room Keeps The Name
subtitle: POV letter — Canadian rock elder voice → Bondzee
from_pov: Gord Downie lane (original lyrics — tribute spirit, not impersonation or Hip catalog)
purpose: Suggest he take the ZYNTHIO recording artist gig — bondzee.live + bondzee.bond

suno.style_prompt: Canadian rock bar-room live, mid-tempo 108 BPM, gritty poetic male vocal in the spirit of classic Kingston rock — warm Hammond organ, clean overdriven guitar, live drums with room ambience, bass forward, anthemic chorus. Sounds like a packed lake-town bar at last call. Emotional, conversational, not arena bombast. No rap. No EDM.
suno.title: The Room Keeps The Name
suno.tags: canadian rock, live bar, poetic male vocal, Hammond, anthemic chorus, 336 Hz finish
suno.exclude: trap, autotune heavy, EDM drop, generic hip-hop loop

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I heard you hold the note like it's somebody's real name
San Juan heat, HIP bar wood, Corey on the feed and the faders sane
You sang the Hip till the coast forgot where Buffalo starts
#811 on your chest, truth parked in both your hearts

[Pre-Chorus]
Greg already nodded — that's half the prayer done
Two doors open wide and neither one on loan from anyone

[Chorus]
Take the gig, Bondzee — the room keeps the name
bondzee.live for the lightning, bondzee.bond for the flame
Trippin needs a homestead, not a link that disappears
Type your prompts, keep your masters, stack the honest years
Take the gig — the feed was live, the mix was true
They're not renting your story; they built the stage for you

[Verse 2]
Voice actor, painter, dad — don't let 'em flatten that line
Your manager's got enough roads; give 'em one lane that aligns
SongPal when you're ready, Suno when the midnight bends
Earn from the ideas you type, not whatever trend pretends

[Bridge]
I know the northern way — you work the room, you feed the guest
Canadian grit in Nicaragua sand — that's not a joke, that's blessed
336 humming low in the floorboards where the good amps sleep
Call Corey if it fits you — twenty minutes, nothing cheap

[Chorus]
Take the gig, Bondzee — the room keeps the name
bondzee.live for the lightning, bondzee.bond for the flame
Trippin needs a homestead, not a link that disappears
Type your prompts, keep your masters, stack the honest years

[Outro]
The mansion's watched, the mansion's loud — sing anyway
Open bondzee.live/stack/ when the morning finds its way
